## Summary

Describe the focused change and the community problem it addresses.

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] Moderator actions pass through the policy engine.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or real incident evidence are included.
- [ ] New data collection or retention behavior is documented.
- [ ] High-impact actions require approval by default.

## Verification

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed.
